title: Detroiters
executive_producers: Sam RichardsonTim RobinsonZach KaninJoe KellyLorne MichaelsJason Sudeikis
premise_summary: Detroiters is an American sitcom created by Sam Richardson, Tim Robinson, Zach Kanin, and Joe Kelly. The series, filmed on location in Detroit, starred native Michiganders Richardson and Robinson. The series premiered on Comedy Central on February 7, 2017 and ran for two seasons. On December 11, 2018, Comedy Central canceled the series.
